summary: Ericsson filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly share repurchases under its existing buyback program announced April 16, 2026. During July 6-10, 2026, it repurchased 2,504,354 Class B shares at an average price of SEK 107.41, totaling SEK 269 million. The program authorizes up to SEK 15 billion, running from April 23, 2026 to March 31, 2027. The Board intends to propose cancellation of repurchased shares at the 2027 AGM. Acquisitions were executed on Nasdaq Stockholm by Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE. Treasury stock now stands at 69.6 million shares. This routine execution update confirms the ongoing capital return program.
